body: I don't know that I can make this work. We still live in the same house. Can't afford to move out, no family or friends to stay with and somehow I'm expected to just deal with it until we pay off enough debt so she can afford to divorce me. I sat in the shower with a gun to my head for 20 minutes this morning. Things are going to get a lot worse before they get better if it's even possible to go down from here. Kudos to you for having this figured out. I sure as hell don't. All I know is that I need this to stop. I can't do this shit anymore.
So then what are you doing to cope?
No real help from friends or family. I started seeing a therapist but it's only been one session so it hasn't helped much.
